05022 Nabowth {naw-both'}

與 05011 同源; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Naboth 22; 22

拿伯 = "結實磊磊"
1) 耶斯列葡萄園的園主, 遭亞哈及耶洗別陰謀陷害而奪走其葡萄園
record.edic_text:
05022 Nabowth {naw-both'}

from the same as 05011;; n pr f pl

AV - Naboth 22; 22

Naboth = "fruits"
1) the vineyard owner of Jezreel who Ahab and Jezebel had killed so
   that they could have his vineyard
